# Serendipity Wellness

> Boutique yoga and massage studio in Edgemead, Northern Suburbs, Cape Town, South Africa. Small-group yoga classes (maximum 5 students) with personal attention, plus rehabilitation yoga, pre- and post-natal yoga, therapeutic massage, reflexology, and meditation and mindfulness (including corporate sessions).

- Founder and teacher: Kerry Nielsen, 200hr qualified yoga teacher and 50hr qualified kids yoga teacher, specialising in therapeutic massage and reflexology, with 10 years of experience
- Location: Edgemead, Northern Suburbs, Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa (home-based studios)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +27 79 085 6100
- Email: info@serendipitywellness.co.za
- Online booking: https://booking.serendipitywellness.co.za/
- Contact page: https://serendipitywellness.co.za/contact/
- Class size: maximum 5 students per yoga class
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/serendipitywellnesscpt/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/serendipitywellnesscpt
- Google Business Profile: https://share.google/IvANP8pmJfdUYsKih

## Services

- [Yoga](https://serendipitywellness.co.za/yoga/): Hatha, Yin and Kids yoga (ages 4–12) in classes of up to 5 students, suitable for beginners and experienced students.
- [Rehabilitation Yoga](https://serendipitywellness.co.za/rehabilitation-yoga/): Personalised packages for recovery after surgery, stroke or heart events, and for back pain, neck pain, joint injuries and arthritis.
- [Pre & Post Natal Yoga](https://serendipitywellness.co.za/pre-post-natal-yoga/): Gentle yoga during pregnancy and after birth; breathing for labour, circulation, pelvic and core recovery.
- [Mindfulness & Meditation](https://serendipitywellness.co.za/mindfulness-meditation/): Guided meditation and mindfulness for individuals, and corporate mindfulness sessions for teams.
- [Therapeutic Massage](https://serendipitywellness.co.za/therapeutic-massage/): Massage for pain, tension, stress and mobility. 30 min R330, 45 min R420, 60 min R485, 90 min R660.
- [Reflexology](https://serendipitywellness.co.za/reflexology/): Gentle, focused thumb and finger pressure on reflex points of the feet, hands and ears for deep relaxation, stress relief and better rest. You stay fully clothed. 45 minutes R295, 60 minutes R370. Not suitable with foot injuries, open wounds, a recent blood clot or in the first trimester of pregnancy; health questionnaire before the first session.

## Class schedule and prices

- [Schedule and Packages](https://serendipitywellness.co.za/schedule-and-packages/)
- Adult classes: Tuesday 9am–10am and 5:30pm–6:30pm; Wednesday 5:30pm–6:30pm; Thursday 5:30pm–6:30pm; Friday 9am–10am; Saturday 8:30am–9:30am and 10am–11am. Bring your own mat.
- Adult fees: drop-in R145 per class; 5 class pass R630; 10 class pass R1050. Packages roll over for 1 month; cancel at least 24 hours before class.
- Private one-on-one classes (studio or at home): from R250 per class.
- Kids Yoga (ages 4–12): R730 for 8 classes per term. Teen Stress Management: R140 per class or R400 for a 4 class pass.

Includes 2 nights' accommodation, 2 breakfasts & 2 dinners, 3 yoga classes, free time, hiking trails and a fire ceremony; optional discounted treatments (aromatherapy massage, reflexology, reiki, Lomi Lomi massage). R3200 sharing, R4800 private room, R900 deposit. Waiting list via WhatsApp on +27 79 085 6100.

Yoga, an introductory talk on QRMA body scanning, a shared brunch, a sound bath and connection with like-minded people. Only 15 spots available. R1100 per person, brunch included. Reserve via WhatsApp on +27 79 085 6100.
